declarations.description:
A form-associated one-time-code field that renders one cell per character. A single native input sits over the
cells, so typing, deleting, pasting, undo and SMS/password-manager autofill (`autocomplete="one-time-code"`) behave
natively, and assistive technology announces one text box rather than a row of fragments. Characters outside `mode`
are dropped, and `complete` fires once every cell is filled.
declarations.name: OtpInput

slots.description: Rich helper content below the cells. `help` and `error-text` are plain-text shortcuts.
slots.name: supporting-text

members.name: value
members.description: Current code. Characters outside `mode` are dropped and the value is cut to `length`.

members.name: length
members.description: Number of cells, i.e. the length of a complete code.

members.name: mode
members.description: Characters accepted: `numeric` (digits, numeric keypad) or `alphanumeric` (letters and digits).

members.name: group
members.description: Splits the cells into groups of this size with a separator between them, e.g. `3` for `123-456`. `0` disables.

members.name: masked
members.description: Shows a dot instead of each entered character.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Single character shown in every empty cell.

members.name: autocomplete
members.description: Browser autocomplete hint. `one-time-code` lets iOS/Android offer a code received by SMS.

members.name: required
members.description: Requires a complete code before the form can be submitted.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Prevents editing while keeping the value in form submission.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Prevents interaction and excludes the value from form submission.

members.name: error
members.description: Applies the visual error state and sets `aria-invalid`.

members.name: help
members.description: Helper text shown below the cells.

members.name: errorText
members.description: Message shown below the cells while `error` is set.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name forwarded to the native input. Defaults to "Verification code".

members.name: clear
members.description: Clears the code and focuses the first cell.

members.name: keepCaretAtEnd
members.description:
The cells show the value left to right with the caret after the last character, so the native caret is pinned
to the end: arrow keys, clicks and selections would otherwise edit a position no cell is highlighting.

events.name: complete
events.description: Fired when user input fills every cell; `detail.value` is the code.
Re-dispatched when typing, deleting or pasting changes the value.
events.name: input

events.description: Re-dispatched when an edited value is committed on blur.
events.name: change
